intro: Burkina Faso has about 23 million people, most of them young.

chapters.title: People
text: The Mossi are the largest group; others include the Fula, Gurunsi, Bobo and Lobi. French is official, and Mooré is widely spoken. Most people are Muslim, with large Christian and traditional-religion communities.
Most people farm millet, sorghum and cotton.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Ouagadougou is the capital; Bobo-Dioulasso is the second city.
